messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.14 canary=15% -> 40% -> 100% change-window=2025-07-23T18:00Z
maya: holding — monitoring alerted INC-2025-113 in eu-west (p95 tail). pausing rollout. @sre-oncall please confirm and advise.
sre-oncall: investigating now. seeing a correlated p95 spike and brief CPU steal on some hosts. pausing traffic to canary pods.
derek: paused via kubectl. ran: kubectl rollout pause deployment/inference-api -n prod && kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/inference-api-canary -n prod
ops-bot: Action: rollout paused for inference-api in prod by derek at 2025-07-23T18:03Z
maya: can we pin back to last-known-good (v2.12) across EU while triaging? prefer full rollback rather than split clients.
derek: pinned to v2.12 across regions using traffic orchestration. curl -X POST https://deploy-api.internal/pin -d '{"service":"inference-api","version":"v2.12"}'
deploy-bot: Pin applied: inference-api -> v2.12 (eu-west, eu-central).
jen-product: I updated the release calendar and put a HOLD note on the public release page. drafting customer comms for EU accounts.
release-manager: add a short blurb to release notes: "Release put on hold due to EU latency incident (INC-2025-113)."
maya: proposal for reschedule: move to 2025-07-24T05:30Z UTC with a reduced canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%), add extended 30m observation between steps, and enable abort hook. objections?
sre-oncall: +1 to smaller canary and longer observation. define clear abort thresholds: p95 latency increase > 25% sustained for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.4% -> abort. also want heap & kernel traces collected from canary pods.
derek: will run a staging traffic replay for 60m against v2.14 with perf profiling. filing ENG-4582 for the replay run.
ops-bot: Action item logged: ENG-4582 "replay traffic for v2.14 in staging" assigned to derek, due 2025-07-24
maya: if traces don't surface a root cause, fallback is to ship v2.14-lean (mem-tweaks) or delay 48h. prefer the lean hotfix if we can validate in staging.
sre-oncall: triage update in 45m. current hypothesis: memory growth exacerbated by a model cache miss scenario combined with kernel preemption. collecting heapdumps and perf traces now.
jen-product: customer note draft posted to #customer-success for review. will ping when the new window is finalized.
release-manager: updated RELEASE-7894 state=HOLD rescheduled_to=2025-07-24T05:30Z notes="INC-2025-113: EU p95 spike; pinned to v2.12; ENG-4582 created"
maya: adding deploy pipeline abort hook with the thresholds above and a Slack alert to this channel. thank you everyone. setting release status to HOLD pending RCA. maya out. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Tickets updated: RELEASE-7894 state=HOLD rescheduled_to=2025-07-24T05:30Z
